D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that a firearm buyback event will take place on June
25; and reminded the community that only safe and sane fireworks are permitted in the city.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Director, announced a community development block cleanup event
and a tire recycling event on June 27; and provided an update on the traffic calming study on Claretta
Ave.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, announced updates regarding recreation: announced the deadline for
the youth summer baseball program signups; that the Fireworks Show will be held on July 2nd; and a Car
Show on July 11.

Mayor Pro Tem Roa asked for a budget review session.

There were no City Attorney Reports.
